name: MoE Run Anyway Managed Expert Loading Contract

boundary.summary: Model Plane owns state, control, cron, and handoff; MoE Run Anyway owns harness/runtime evidence and planning artifacts.

does_not_own: MoE Run Anyway replay policy scoring

modes.description: Collect capability labels, inventory hints, telemetry, and missing actuator fields without changing runtime state.
Apply managed-loading policy vocabulary to recorded or synthetic traces and compare against dense fallback.
Future guarded mode that would apply residency actions to a backend after all actuator capabilities are proven.

state_vocab.description: The expert is currently available in the active execution memory tier.
The expert is staged in host memory and may be promoted if an actuator exists.
The expert is staged on local disk or SSD and may be promoted if an actuator exists.
A future actuator has accepted a load request and the residency transition is not complete.
A future actuator has accepted an eviction or demotion request and the transition is not complete.
The harness cannot prove the current residency tier.

policy_actions.description: Emit observations and missing-capability fields without attempting runtime mutation.
Request an expert load before the policy expects it to be routed.
Keep an expert resident across a policy window or request boundary.
Leave an expert in its current residency state.
Remove an expert from the active resident set.
Move an expert to a lower residency tier such as CPU or disk.
Use normal dense or full-residency execution instead of managed loading.
Stop the managed-loading attempt when required capabilities or safety checks are missing.

backend_adapters.description: Stock llama.cpp evidence path and possible future small-patch substrate.
backend_adapters.adapter_boundary: Stock endpoint observability can provide runtime evidence; real managed loading would require a narrow runtime patch or upstream-supported control point.

backend_adapters.description: Endpoint-compatible backend class that needs a plugin or extension for MoE internals.
backend_adapters.adapter_boundary: OpenAI-compatible request telemetry is runtime evidence only unless a backend plugin exposes MoE internals.

backend_adapters.description: Local Python-module runtime class that can expose semantic routing traces through hooks.
backend_adapters.adapter_boundary: Forward hooks and module inspection can expose inventory and routing when a local runtime already provides Python modules.

backend_adapters.description: External offload-capable runtime class that could become an adapter target if already installed.
backend_adapters.adapter_boundary: A candidate adapter class for an already installed offload-capable runtime; this plan does not vendor, install, or launch it.

backend_adapters.description: Local prototype class for exercising the contract before a production backend actuator exists.
backend_adapters.adapter_boundary: A future local prototype may exercise the contract, but it must prove the same safety, fallback, cleanup, and artifact requirements as other backends.
missing_actuator_capabilities: dense fallback comparison under live conditions

capability_requirements.description: Produce model id, backend family, layer id, expert id, storage/residency cost, and load capability from a real or fixture source.
Expose semantic layer/expert routing scores or ranks from hooks, runtime exports, or trace fixtures.
Read an expert's current residency state from the runtime.
Apply preload, pin, evict, demote, and related residency transitions in a live backend.
Translate replay decisions into guarded backend adapter calls only when the adapter has required capabilities.
Keep normal dense or full-residency execution available as the comparison and escape path.
Restore runtime state after abort, failed mutation, interruption, or dense fallback.
Emit memory-moe-bridge-v1-compatible managed-loading artifacts with before/after state and capability gaps.

current_capability_gaps.impact: The harness cannot prove where live expert tensors reside.
current_capability_gaps.needed_before_live: Backend adapter must expose auditable residency state for each expert.

current_capability_gaps.impact: The harness cannot load, pin, evict, demote, or otherwise move live experts.
current_capability_gaps.needed_before_live: Backend adapter must provide guarded mutation calls and visible before/after state.

current_capability_gaps.impact: A failed live actuator experiment could leave runtime state ambiguous.
current_capability_gaps.needed_before_live: Abort paths must restore dense/full-residency behavior or prove no mutation occurred.

current_capability_gaps.impact: Stock endpoint telemetry cannot be treated as semantic expert routing.
current_capability_gaps.needed_before_live: Selected backend must expose routed layer/expert ids and scores at the decision point.

safety_contract: Planner does not authenticate or inspect private tokens.
Planner does not launch model servers.
Planner does not send prompt traffic.
Planner does not mutate runtime state or model caches.
Live expert loading is not implemented yet.
next_actions: Keep the current pass observe-only and replay/simulate only.
Use runtime baseline artifacts to label backend capability gaps.
Use hookable PyTorch traces only when local modules and weights already exist.
Design a backend adapter only after inventory, routing visibility, residency observation, dense fallback, artifact export, and cleanup requirements are proven.
Do not claim live managed expert loading until a live actuator is implemented and tested.
